audit_document: # GOVERNANCE STAGE MAPPING — CURRENT vs GOVERNED OBJECTIVE

03_OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION_CURRENT: The current formulation implements a SINGLE WEIGHTED-SUM objective. There is no strict lexicographic priority enforced by the solver.
Stage 1 (critical load reliability) is represented by the p_unmet penalty coefficient (10.0 $/Wh * dt) — a large penalty intended to discourage unmet load, but NOT a hard lexicographic constraint.

Stage 2 (emergency battery reserve / terminal reserve) has NO explicit coefficient in the current c vector. It is represented implicitly via battery SOC bounds (min_soc_pct=20%) enforced as variable bounds, not as an objective term.
Stage 3 (diesel/fuel minimization) is represented by p_diesel, u_diesel, v_start coefficients — correctly penalized.
Stage 4 (renewable curtailment) is represented by p_curt_sol and p_curt_wind coefficients — correctly penalized.

The EMS Objective Specification V2 (governed) requires STRICT lexicographic priority: Stage 1 must never be violated to satisfy Stage 3 or 4. The current weighted-sum formulation cannot guarantee this without penalty tuning.
This observation is NOT a finding about mathematical transferability. It characterizes the GAP between current implementation and governed objective.
